name: p1-todo-tags
title: Tags for the todo tool
kind: new feature in an existing small codebase
tests: Carrying a list of small rules (AND filter, case, validation, counts) and one compatibility constraint (old data files) from a chatty brief into the spec.
left_open: Order of tags on a line (tests accept any order)
Whether a tag with no open tasks is listed by `tags` (tests accept absent or 0)
Output of `tags` on an empty store (tests only require exit 0)
inferred: The same tag given twice on one task is stored once
